title: Quote of the day by Vladimir Putin on AI: 'Whoever becomes the leader in this sphere will become the ruler of the world' — an outlook on geopolitical dominance
excerpt: The long-serving Russian president has long seen AI as the pathway to dominance in the next era of humankind
content_html:
The AI buildout has not just captured the attention of the biggest technology companies in the world, but also the global superpowers, including the US and China in particular. The growth of this technology, which is still nascent, is seen as not just a competitive advantage for domestic businesses, but a fundamental development that can be harnessed to dominate the world stage in the future.

AI prescience

The Russian president, Vladimir Putin, was speaking to Russian students shortly after Google scientists published their seminal study that outlined the transformer architecture that defines modern AI systems.

Quote of the day

This article is part of TechRadar Pro's QOTD project to provide an insight into the minds of the brightest and most recognized figures in the technology industry today and in years gone by. Read the full series here.

His comments came in the context of national security and the balance of geopolitical power, with many world leaders long understanding that AI would be at the heart of not just commercial technologies but military capabilities.

His thoughts also balanced the notion of benefits that may arise with the threats, both by humans wielding AI tools as well as from the AI systems themselves. Elon Musk, for example, had previously highlighted the idea that AI could lead to a third world war.

Modern warfare

It's become increasingly clear just how prominent the role of AI and autonomous weapons is playing in international conflicts nearly ten years on, including in the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022 — and the battles that have ensued since.

Geopolitically, both the US and China are also each defining their own AI strategy, with both nations desperately building out their capabilities in a way that ensures dominance while respecting and maintaining ongoing international trade and commerce.

Although the technology hasn't reached the point where one single country or superpower can dominate the era to come, the US has begun strategically restricting the release of AI models, like Mythos, on the basis that they're becoming too powerful to get into the wrong hands.

content_html_zh:
人工智能的建设不仅引起了世界上最大的科技公司的关注，也引起了全球超级大国的关注，尤其是美国和中国。 这项仍处于萌芽阶段的技术的发展不仅被视为国内企业的竞争优势，而且是未来可用于主宰世界舞台的根本性发展。

人工智能预知力

在谷歌科学家发表其开创性研究概述了定义现代人工智能系统的变压器架构后不久，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京就对俄罗斯学生发表了讲话。

当日报价

本文是 TechRadar Pro 的 QOTD 项目的一部分，旨在深入了解当今和过去几年技术行业中最聪明、最受认可的人物的想法。 在这里阅读完整系列。

他的评论是在国家安全和地缘政治力量平衡的背景下发表的，许多世界领导人长期以来都认识到人工智能不仅是商业技术的核心，而且是军事能力的核心。

他的想法还平衡了人类使用人工智能工具以及人工智能系统本身可能带来的好处和威胁。 例如，埃隆·马斯克此前曾强调人工智能可能导致第三次世界大战的想法。

现代战争

近十年来，人工智能和自主武器在国际冲突中发挥着多么突出的作用，这一点已经变得越来越明显，包括俄罗斯 2022 年入侵乌克兰以及此后发生的战斗。

从地缘政治角度来看，美国和中国也都在制定自己的人工智能战略，两国都在拼命增强自己的能力，以确保主导地位，同时尊重和维持持续的国际贸易和商业。

尽管这项技术还没有达到一个国家或超级大国能够主宰未来时代的程度，但美国已经开始战略性地限制像Mythos这样的人工智能模型的发布，理由是它们已经变得太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。
